title: Chapter 163
text:
The nozzle, conduit, and fuel tank of the Sunworm were combined into one. It looked like an insulating metal pipe that was about twenty centimeters long. It was as wide as a vambrace and could be tied to one's arms and calves. It looked like a beetle, and its chelicerae were rows of leather and metal buckles.

He wore the Sunworm on the inside of his left forearm. It looked a little bloated, but he could ignore it since he had sixty-nine points of strength.

The Sunworm is most suitable to be used as a mecha module. It can be integrated into my self-made lightweight mecha. Han Xiao was still thinking about lightweight mechas, and he already had an idea. He had booked the Fabian Corporation's transport plane and could build a lightweight mecha while he was in the newbie village.

At this time, a white-haired Asian man walked over and stared at Han Xiao's Ghost sniper rifle. He said in surprise, "You didn't see wrongly. This is an electromagnetic weapon!" He then turned to look at Han Xiao and asked, "Do you want to sell this gun? I'm willing to pay five hundred thousand … no, one million!"

Han Xiao sized him up and had an idea. He pretended not to know and asked, "Who are you?"

"I'm Lei Zhen Yu, the chief consultant of mechanical technology invited by Lu Cheng. You seem to be a mechanic too. You should have heard of my name."

Han Xiao did not respond.

"Don't tell me you haven't heard of my name before. Are you a self-taught mechanic? That's rare." Lei Zhen Yu was surprised. He shook his head and asked directly, "I want this electromagnetic gun. Name a price."

"Do I look like I lack money?" Han Xiao pointed at the expensive parts on the lathe. Lei Zhen Yu's eyes lit up.

"You're a self-taught mechanic, so I can teach you. In exchange for this gun, you definitely need a master like me to guide you. You can only follow the advice of your seniors and not go down the wrong path. I can see that you actually want to learn from a master. I'm here, and I'm open to you. This is a once in a lifetime opportunity. If you miss it, you will regret it for the rest of your life."

He did not know that this electromagnetic sniper rifle was made by Han Xiao. In his impression, self-taught mechanics were all very bad, so he wanted to teach Han Xiao in exchange for this sniper rifle. He was a master mechanic, and he would not teach normal people even if they wanted to learn. He wanted to give Han Xiao a precious opportunity. As long as Han Xiao knew what was good for him, he felt that it was more than enough to exchange for the electromagnetic sniper rifle.

Han Xiao's eyes twitched. This was the first time he had heard such shameless self-praise. He was almost as good as him.

In fact, Han Xiao knew Lei Zhen Yu's background. This guy was very famous in the Blue Star's mechanic world. He was a very high-level mechanic, and it was not wrong to call him a master. He was from the same era as Old Man Lu. He was active a few decades ago and had retired long ago. He was like Old Man Lu and did not have the demeanor of a master.

Han Xiao knew why Lei Zhen Yu appeared in Black Pine. Speaking of which, it was related to Old Man Lu's four blueprints mission. Lei Zhen Yu happened to be part of this complicated hidden mission.

Back then, Lu Cheng left his daughter, who was only a few years old, to be raised by Old Man Lu. He entered the wilderness and became a warlord. Because of this, Old Man Lu quarreled with him. He could not understand Lu Cheng's choice. The relationship between father and son was very stiff.

Lu Cheng became a powerful warlord in the Southern Continent step by step and faced all kinds of dangers.

On the surface, Old Man Lu did not want to have any contact with his son. In fact, he was secretly watching Lu Cheng. He asked his old friend Lei Zhen Yu to come to Black Pine to help and protect Lu Cheng. Lu Cheng knew nothing about this. He was very surprised that he could invite a master to take care of the Munitions Factory.

When the four blueprints were about to start, Lei Zhen Yu had to leave Black Pine. Old Man Lu helped Lu Cheng in another way. He did not want to see Lu Cheng in an awkward situation, so he left the blueprints and left the Western Capital. His whereabouts were unknown.

"Maybe this is my father." Han Xiao sighed. Why was Zhu Ziqing's "Back View" a classic? It was because people who experienced it would resonate with it. Even an old man like Old Man Lu was worried about it.

Suppressing his emotions, Han Xiao calmed down and said, "I can exchange with you. I want the advanced knowledge."

According to his memory, Lei Zhen Yu knew the advanced knowledge, but players could not learn it from him. He wanted to give it a try.

Lei Zhen Yu said, "Young man, don't bite off more than you can chew. You are a self-taught mechanic. Your level is not high enough to understand the advanced knowledge. I will teach you something else."

"No, I only want the advanced knowledge."

Lei Zhen Yu said, "But you can't understand it."

"That's good. You don't have to worry about me learning it. I will just look at it for an hour. Just treat it as me being curious."

Lei Zhen Yu was speechless. The advanced knowledge was very precious. It was a top secret, and it was not easily taught. It was crucial to control the source of the knowledge. Although he was curious about the structure of the electromagnetic gun, it was not valuable enough to exchange for the advanced knowledge. Even if Han Xiao said that he could not understand it, he did not want to take the risk.

Lei Zhen Yu hesitated for a while and did not give up. "I can't teach you the advanced knowledge, but I can use the advanced knowledge to create a machine to exchange with you."

Sure enough, it was not easy to obtain the advanced knowledge. Han Xiao was already mentally prepared, so he was not upset. Instead, he thought about Lei Zhen Yu's suggestion. If he used the machine that he knew how to create to exchange for a new machine of the same level, it would not be a loss.

However, the Ghost sniper rifle that he had with him was an improved version. He still needed to use it, so he planned to create a new one to exchange with Lei Zhen Yu.

Han Xiao nodded and agreed to this suggestion. "I will create a new one for you."

"You made this gun?" Lei Zhen Yu was shocked. He saw that Han Xiao was a stranger and that he was a self-taught mechanic. He thought that the gun was made by someone else. He did not expect that he was wrong.

The Six Nations were all secretly developing electromagnetic weapons, and they had not even passed the experimental stage. Just the fact that Han Xiao could create an electromagnetic weapon that was barely stable meant that he was on the same level as him. Lei Zhen Yu thought about how he had called himself a master, and even with his old face, he felt a little embarrassed.

He actually dared to put on airs in front of a mechanic on the same level. It was too embarrassing.

Luckily, Lei Zhen Yu was thick-skinned. He quickly put away the contempt in his heart and corrected his attitude. He saw Han Xiao as an existence on the same level as him.

At this time, a guard hurriedly walked over and whispered in his ear that Han Xiao was also a legendary assassin.

Lei Zhen Yu was shocked. He looked at Han Xiao from head to toe. There were many mechanics who knew how to research, but those who could fight were rare. His respect for Han Xiao went up another level.

With strength, he would be valued no matter where he went.

"Please come with me. I will show you my storage room." Lei Zhen Yu coughed and quickly changed the topic to ease the awkwardness. There was a hint of respect in his tone.

The two of them came to the forbidden area in the Munitions Factory. This was the living room of the high-level researchers. Lei Zhen Yu's room was a spacious suite. It had all the daily necessities, including a wine cabinet and a bookcase. They were all handmade with maroon high-quality wood. They were expensive. There was even a simple small lathe in the corner of the room.

Lei Zhen Yu opened the wine cabinet and activated the secret door. The wine cabinet slid open, revealing a secret storage room. He called Han Xiao in. There were glass cabinets against the wall. They were filled with mechanical equipment. Lei Zhen Yu went straight to the innermost cabinet.

"I have four pieces of equipment made with advanced knowledge. Let me introduce them to you." Lei Zhen Yu pointed at the glass cabinets and started talking.

Lei Zhen Yu's advanced knowledge was focused on micro modification. These four advanced machines were all related to nano.

"Nurse Type-I" Biological Particle. It looked like a thick black gel, but it was actually a decomposed special nanoparticle. It could be injected into the body. When injured, poisoned, or bleeding, it could quickly get rid of negative effects, remove toxins, and speed up blood coagulation. It was a consumable used in medical treatment.

"U9 Colloidal Bulletproof Film. It looked like transparent glass. When hit, it would temporarily solidify to offset the kinetic energy. It would then solidify and clamp the object. For example, when a bullet was shot, it would be clamped in an instant. It was as if the bullet was originally inside. It looked like transparent amber. It had high defensive properties and was not easy to damage. It was suitable to be made into a bulletproof vest.

"Fermilo Condensate. It looked like a pile of shaving cream foam. It was used to cool down the interior of the machine and reduce the cooldown time of the machine. It would then degrade quickly without blocking the operation of the machine's internal components. For example, the Sunworm's cooldown time was 20 seconds. Fermilo Condensate could reduce the cooldown time to three to five seconds. The effect was obvious. It was also a consumable.

"PE-0 Nano Artificial Fiber. It looked like a biological tendon. It was completely black with a smooth surface. It was very tough. It was a nano material. When twisted and stretched, it would produce elasticity that far exceeded its volume.
